votes.motion: Close nominations and open voting (by ballot) for Vice Chair of the RDA
votes.description: The Board closed nominations and proceeded to vote by ballot for the Vice Chair position of the Redevelopment Agency for the remainder of the one-year term. Director Dugan received five ballots in his favor and was elected Vice Chair.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 11 of 2023 to amend the FY 2022-2023 budget of all remaining items
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the Redevelopment Agency's final budget for Fiscal Year 2022-23, including adjustments based on actual property tax increment received, interlocal agreements, reimbursement agreements, and holding accounts for capital improvements and strategic intervention funds.
